theme: What If Things Were Different (Mixed Conditionals)
phoneme_focus: Linking across clause boundaries; contrastive stress on time shift

grammar_point.title: Mixed conditionals
grammar_point.en: Mix time frames: past condition -> present result, and present condition -> past result.
grammar_point.ar: خلط الأزمنة: شرط ماضٍ ← نتيجة حاضرة، وشرط حاضر ← نتيجة ماضية.

Saturday.prompt: Say two 'If I had..., I would be... now' sentences.

Sunday.prompt: Say two 'If I were..., I would have...' sentences.

Monday.prompt: Explain how a past choice still affects your present, using mixed conditionals.

Tuesday.prompt: Link a personality trait to a past outcome ('If I were more..., I wouldn't have...').

Wednesday.prompt: Reflect on how your life would be different now, but end positively.

Thursday.prompt: Discuss with a partner how one past choice shapes your present.

Friday.prompt: Analyse the past-present links in your life (9-10 sentences) with mixed conditionals.
